qt: to the Commission Valentina Palmisano (The Left) Subject:

In 2024, 23.9% of EU citizens aged 16 and over – approximately 90 million people – reported a disability. in the same year, 28.8 % of persons with disabilities were at risk of poverty or social exclusion, with national values ranging from 15.6 to 45.8 %. These figures highlight persistent inequalities, exacerbated by regional disparities in the availability of personal assistance, home care services, accessible services, mobility support and assistance with labour-market inclusion. Article 19 of the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, which is binding on the European Union, recognises the right to independent living and inclusion in the community; Articles 21 and 26 of the Charter of Fundamental Rights prohibit discrimination and recognise autonomy and participation; and Regulation (EU) 2021/1057 allocates at least 25 % of the ESF + to social inclusion. In light of the above: 1.
How will the Commission ensure that ESF + and ERDF fund personalised, accessible and non-segregating local services?
Will it introduce additional regional indicators to measure access to services, quality of care and independent living?
What measures will it take to reduce regional disparities and ensure the participation of representative organisations in the programming, monitoring and evaluation of European funds?
